key_points: Fiscal 2027 revenue growth guidance cut to 8%-9% from 9%-10%, entirely driven by Credit Karma slowdown (3%-7% vs 11%-13% prior)
Mailchimp sold to Bending Spoons for $3.7B vs $12B purchase price, realizing a massive loss on a strategic asset
Credit Karma generated 52% of Upstart's loans in 2020, indicating platform dependency and broader fintech headwinds
Stock declined ~13% on the combined news, signaling market reassessment of growth trajectory
Divestiture suggests management prioritizing AI focus over underperforming acquisitions, but at significant cost
